response.sql: WITH invoice_metrics AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(derived_product_cost) AS avg_line_product_cost, AVG(derived_total_cost / NULLIF(product_price, 0)) AS invoice_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(invoice_ratio) AS avg_invoice_ratio FROM invoice_metrics) SELECT AVG(i.avg_line_product_cost) AS avg_line_product_cost, AVG(i.invoice_ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(i.invoice_ratio - o.avg_invoice_ratio) AS avg_ratio_excess FROM invoice_metrics AS i CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE i.invoice_ratio > o.avg_invoice_ratio

assumptions.assumption: A line with a zero product_price has an undefined ratio and is excluded from ratio averages.
